Retrieved 30 September 2021 It plays their home matches at the [[Estádio Cidade de Barcelos]]. It competes in the [[Primeira Liga]], the top division of football in the country, and it is named after Portuguese playwright [[Gil Vicente]]. The club's founding occurred near the city's theater named after playwright Vicente. It first played in Primeira Liga in [[1990–91 Primeira Divisão|1990–91]]. Since then, the team has been relegated to the second tier three times, having won back promotion twice by winning the [[Segunda Liga]] and once by administrative decision. The highest league finishes were two fifth-places in [[1999–2000 Primeira Liga|1999–2000]] and [[2021–22 Primeira Liga|2021–22]]. A women's football team was created for the 2018–19 season. The team has participated in the [[Campeonato Nacional Feminino|top tier]], and currently has played six straight seasons in it."}}
